title: SMMC ModPack
description: "Slightly Modded" Minecraft is a semi-vanilla experience for both beginners and veterans with a focus on exploration
body:
"Slightly Modded" Minecraft is a semi-vanilla experience that began as a personal project with a goal to create an enjoyable and upgraded Minecraft experience, without taking away from the core mechanics of the game. It's built to enhance the minecraft expereince and change it only as needed. It's beginner friendly, but with enough complexity and late game additions for veteren players to enjoy as well.

This modpack contains: multiple world generation mods to populate the world with a plethora of biomes and structures to explore (in every dimension), optional late game areas to continue the need for progress, many quality of life changes, wonderful terrain to traverse, and lots of memories to be made.

For the best effect it is recommended to use Iris shaders, and the provided resource packs. It is all optional of course to preserve performance!

This mod is enjoyable in an offline singlplayer setting, or with friends on a server!



*I DO NOT OWN ANY MODS IN THIS MODPACK AND CLAIM NO RIGHTS TO ANY OF IT*

This modpack is a passion project and should be treated as such with free distribution and editing.
